title: Grateful Dead Live at NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park on 1969-07-11
venue: NY State Pavilion, Flushing Meadow Park
source: SBD Recording Info: Pat Lee from Dick Latvala MC > C > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a laid‑back July ’69 outdoor show with decent clarity; highlights include the jammed Dupree’s > Dire Wolf and a trippy Other One, though instrument separation is limited.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that presents a slightly hissy but listenable mix – solos, especially Jerry's guitar, come through clearly while overall instrument separation is modest. Musically the concert feels relaxed, with standout moments like Dupree’s > Dire Wolf, Casey Jones organ work and an exploratory Other One, though some songs suffer from brief tuning pauses and a missing Alligator segment.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review points to a solid performance with several highlights and an acceptable soundboard recording, offset by modest audio clarity issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight hiss audible during breaks; instrument separation is rough making some parts hard to distinguish, but solos (especially Jerry's) are clear and overall mix is listenable.

standout_songs: Sitting on Top of the World > Big Boss
show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed, outdoors vibe with an early pacing slowdown due to tuning issues that later opens up into longer jams and the Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar solos come across well; lets loose on 'Sitting on Top of the World' and provides backup vocals.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is hard to hear early on, becomes clearer later in the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals noted on 'Mama Tried'; generally solid rhythm guitar work.
band_member_comments.Drums: Top‑hat tapping and drumming presence noted, especially during jams.
